user.title: Sign in to Skylight
user.description:
1. [Open Skylight sign-in]({auth_url}) in a new tab.
2. Sign in with your Skylight email and password.
3. When the page finishes loading, look at your browser's address bar — it will contain `?code=…`.
4. Copy the value of `code` (or the whole URL — either works) and paste it below.

pick_frame.title: Choose your Skylight frame
pick_frame.description: Your Skylight account has more than one frame. Pick which one to set up now — you can add the others later.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Skylight API. Try again in a moment.
error.invalid_auth: That code was rejected — codes expire in about 30 seconds. Click the link again to get a fresh one.
error.invalid_code: That doesn't look like a Skylight authorization code. Paste the value of `code=` from the address bar (or the whole URL).
error.no_frames: No Skylight frames were found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This Skylight frame is already configured.
abort.all_frames_configured: Every frame on this account is already configured in Home Assistant.

upload_media.name: Upload media
upload_media.description: Upload a photo or short video to a Skylight frame.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Absolute path to the media file. Must be readable by Home Assistant.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Optional caption shown alongside the photo on the frame.

frame_id.name: Frame ID
frame_id.description: Only required with multiple frames configured.
